data.name: Master Explorer
data.description: You add %1 to all Disable Device and Perception checks. You can disable traps in half the normal amount of time (minimum 1 round) and open a lock as a standard action. You can always take 10 on Disable Device and Stealth checks. You can use Disable Device to disarm magical traps.|PaDSkillBonus
